info.title: ciele API
info.description: The public Organization API for Ciele. Requests and responses use JSON. Create an API key in Settings → API Keys and send it as `Authorization: Bearer ciele_sk_…`. Protected operations state their required capability. Lists use the pagination parameters shown on each operation. This contract describes the public `/api/v1` surface; internal console and widget routes are not API key endpoints.
